answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one vault weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The beacon report exposes the merge explicitly at each nectar. Because of that, anyone who spins up 181 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 138 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3427 identities would post 1186 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
